acceptedScope: The bounded language mechanisms may remain in the unregistered generic quantified-English research module and may be invoked by the label-isolating development adapter.
generalityEvidence: Nonce entity constants, classes, binary relations, object constants, and surface verbs are renamed together while preserving the typed formula shape.
Exchanging the relative and main predications changes implication scope and therefore changes the audited formula.
Implication and biconditional surfaces produce different typed operators under otherwise identical renamed vocabulary.
Shared-predicate subject coordination and complete-clause coordination preserve different term assignments.
Premise formula reordering preserves the query prediction.
The exact semantic audit compares alpha-normalized typed formulas and reports mismatches without using annotations to repair candidates or generate predictions.
The generic module contains no benchmark, dataset, row, answer, source-family, or inspected-example dispatch string.
abstentionAndAmbiguity: A relative-clause boundary is accepted only when all successful boundaries yield one typed formula; competing formulas remain AMBIGUOUS.
A binary relation or constant resolver tie remains AMBIGUOUS.
Unsupported lexical evidence falls through to the previously accepted controlled constructions rather than claiming a new typed coreference parse.
Input length and recursive composition retain the existing 4,096-character and depth-24 bounds.
registrationBlockers: Only 545 of 1,292 development sentence slots compile and only 383 of 1,279 parseable official annotations match exactly.
Only 4 of 204 complete natural-language cases are correct because every premise and the conclusion must compile exactly enough to execute.
The pinned official release exposes no public untouched test split, so the required fresh language-coverage evidence is unavailable.
Registering the module in Stage A would require explicit specification, capability, engine, documentation, and wider cross-source review outside this delegated change boundary.
rejectedRelaxations: Do not choose one of several supported relative-clause boundaries from lexical overlap.
Do not collapse subject coordination and complete-clause coordination into an untyped conjunction.
Do not invent a binary predicate, object class, entity constant, or pronoun referent when the adapter resolver has no unique typed mapping.
Do not use official formulas or labels as parser inputs, candidate repairs, or answer selectors.
Do not branch on source names, record identifiers, hashes, expected answers, or inspected vocabulary.
nextGate: Acquire a genuinely untouched authorized language-evidence partition, freeze candidate dependencies before execution, and require improved exact semantic-formula coverage without regression before proposing Stage A registration.
